annotations.title: Will They Pay Me On Time?

description: A large customer's payment habits from the supplier's side, with what its lateness is worth on your invoice. From the company's statutory Payment Practices reports - typical days to pay against your terms, the share paid late and past 60 days, the trend over its last reports - and the statutory interest plus fixed compensation its typical lateness is worth on an invoice of your size. A company that doesn't report is said so. 1 credit. Use this when you supply (or are quoting) the company and want the cost on your invoice; for the plain record and its benchmark use payment_practices.

company.description: A UK company number (8 characters, such as 00502851 or SC123456) is surest; a name also works and goes to the closest registered company, which the reply names. Use company_search first when a name could mean several companies.
